prompt_en: Create a photorealistic editorial photograph of the unmistakably adult person from the attached reference image as an astronomical instrument technician inside a high-altitude observatory calibration room before dawn. Preserve the reference image's adult facial appearance and adult-age continuity. Stage a decision uncertainty display—a restrained decision-uncertainty display—at a waist-high optical bench. In one medium three-quarter frame, two distinct physical options remain visible, a crimson round cassette and a cyan square-edged cassette. Her gaze and slight head angle divide between the two options; one eyebrow rises asymmetrically while the brow lightly knits, and her lips hold mild tension. Her eyes divide between the two options while her slight head angle supports the same comparison; slight brow asymmetry with mild lip tension is visible on her face. Her gloved right hand keeps a precision spectral loupe paused exactly midway above the gap before selection; the precision spectral loupe tool pauses midway between options before contact. Neither option has yet been selected and the calibration slot remains empty. Arrange both filter pads and the empty slot as a shallow foreground triangle around the suspended loupe. Balance red instrument task light against cool predawn window light, with tactile metal, optical glass, and frost detail.
